source.order: Official raw metadata CSV physical row order, is_in_upsampling True, first previously unconsumed visit; all historical consumed capture IDs propagated through metadata to visits; first time-complete capture per visit, no alternative capture after label gate failure
source.old6: permanently development; exclude all their visits
source.windows: First two chronological non-overlapping16-grid-point windows meeting native RGB/depth/K time completeness; choose and seal window times before any labels. No alternative windows after label gate fail.
source.grid_origin: First common native RGB/depth/K timestamp of capture
source.missing_FARO: Preserve grid frame with ToF UNKNOWN; never delete, duplicate or impute
source.eligibility: Temporal completeness only; FARO validity or coverage does not select windows
source.gate_scope: Combined two windows per visit, reference-only; preserve rejected candidates and never relax thresholds
source.assets: HEAD every relevant archive/trajectory before its download; log full compressed asset bytes plus planned Range bytes. Existing RangeZIP select required members; enforce global actual transferred byte cap incl retries. If budget cannot support next whole candidate, stop/reduce count without split reassignment.

geometry.input: FARO registered2.5D first-visible depth, no native hole filling
geometry.time: FARO/source pose -> world -> grid pose; readout peak3D grid -> RGB pose -> native27query; retain RGB,FARO,trajectory residuals
geometry.limitations: FARO independent capture but official native agreement selection bias; constant reflectance/plane-normal proxy; no intensity

arms.name: native_circular_upper
arms.scope: circular optimistic diagnostic, not actual ToF capability

noise.seed_rule: SeedSequence([20261011, accepted_visit_ordinal, window_index, frame_index, noise_index]); same seed across arms, new sample distribution per expectation; no replicate treated as independent scene

readout.tof: Exact frozen seal thresholds SNR>=3,coverage>=.75,16 pixels; observable signed peak and sampled background
readout.RGB: DAVrawR0>=.8m; UnirawR0near; all accepted frames raw inference, no fit; public registered grid, invalid model pixels never remove denominators
readout.fusion: fixed pixel-levelOR/AND(ToF, bandedRGB) then16pixel; same native POS witness restriction

allowed: M3/S raw inference sealed only if no method aggregation
forbidden: any method summary or cutoff tuning
eval.output: Separate sealed eval directories; metrics CLI refuses eval. Do not load eval raw prediction payloads for analysis; hashes only.

M3_S: Frozen weights/features/thresholds, original HEAD/BODY only; train/cal alarm rates descriptive per window/arm/K, no contact accuracy. Eval raw output only without summary if budget, else NOT_RUN. Batch model loads to respect GPU budget.
decision_check: At least32midfarFREE per accepted visit; minima are query counts, not statistical validation.16nearPOS and32FREE may fail early fixed windows: record deficits, no gate relaxation. No method selection occurs.
stop: Complete scoped delivery or cumulative budget; preserve partial outputs and failures, report gaps. No protected480/test; no model training; release GPU.
